kpis.name: Total Cycle Time from Purchase Requisition to Invoice Payment
kpis.description: The total time taken from the creation of the purchase requisition to the payment of the invoice.

smart_breakdown.specific: Measures the entire duration of the procure-to-pay process.
smart_breakdown.measurable: Computed as the average time from 'Create Purchase Requisition' to 'Pay invoice'. Unit: hours.
smart_breakdown.achievable: This target is realistic as it encompasses the entire process, allowing for identification of bottlenecks.
smart_breakdown.relevant: Directly addresses the goal of paying suppliers sooner by focusing on the complete cycle time.
smart_breakdown.time_bound: Evaluated across all simulated cases in the run

kpis.suggested_formula: AVG(End_Time('Pay invoice') - Start_Time('Create Purchase Requisition')) across completed cases

kpis.name: Invoice Release Waiting Time
kpis.description: Average time an invoice waits after the previous step is completed before it is released for payment.

smart_breakdown.specific: Measures the gap between the completion of the previous step and the start of 'Release Supplier's Invoice'.
smart_breakdown.measurable: Computed as the average time from the end of the previous step to the start of 'Release Supplier's Invoice'. Unit: hours.
smart_breakdown.achievable: Reducing this wait time is feasible through improved workflow management and timely follow-ups.
smart_breakdown.relevant: Addresses the goal of ensuring invoices do not remain unattended before processing.
smart_breakdown.time_bound: Evaluated across all simulated cases in the run

kpis.suggested_formula: AVG(Start_Time('Release Supplier's Invoice') - End_Time(previous_step)) across completed cases, where previous_step is the activity before 'Release Supplier's Invoice'
